sources.title: sdxl-vae: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview sdxl-vae is a fine-tuned variational autoencoder designed to improve local, high-frequency detail reconstruction in SDXL (Stable Diffusion XL) generated images. Developed by stabilityai, this component operates as a drop-in replacement for the original latent diffusion model's autoencoder, integrating seamlessly into diffusers workflows via the AutoencoderKL class.
